title: Imagine Children's Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Imagine Children’s Museum welcomes all children and their adults, of all abilities, ages, ethnicities, genders, immigration statuses, races, religions, sexual orientations, and socioeconomic statuses. We are committed to ensuring all guests have a positive and safe experience. We expect our staff and guests to act responsibly, and be kind and considerate of others as we share this space. Children visiting Imagine Children’s Museum must be accompanied by an adult who is 18 years or older. Adults are responsible for supervising the children in their group at all times.
